payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute 2D DP table dp[i][j] = number of ways to reach cell i after j moves. Then compute per-cell visit count c[i] = sum_t dp[i][t] * dp[i][k-t] to answer sum over all paths in O(1) per update.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a DP table with two dimensions (position i and step j), which is a classic dp_2d_state pattern. It does not use tree, interval, knapsack, or memoized recursion variants.
